prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create two complementary high-resolution editorial portraits of an adult woman with long naturally wavy brown hair seated in the back seat of a modern unbranded luxury car with dark leather and refined wood-like trim. She wears a fitted black long-sleeve knit top and high-waisted black tailored trousers. In the first portrait she faces forward with one hand resting naturally by the window; in the second she gently looks over one shoulder in a relaxed three-quarter rear-seat pose. Use soft daylight through the window, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, sharp interior material detail, and passing greenery softly blurred outside. The mood is cool, composed, and understated luxury; no brands, logos, or readable text.
